content: Bormogi-burbar-sunmaklenaid
Deunni, anmar birgabakebakgus Babiloniaʼgi-bukwadgine, gaka nii-warambegwad-ibambegine, Bab-Jehová weyob anga sokalid:
“Dule-machi, emi-iba-naid be narmake, ar Babilonia-e-rey Jerusalén-dulemargi-bila-onogega emi-ibagi Jerusalén-ebiris bukwad.
We-dulemar-uayasulidamaladga burbar-sunmakleged be soge. Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi, weyob sogye ega be soge:

content.text: Nue dii gwakwarmakegala, bormo-urba sapanmar be yoe-yoe sao,

content: Ar Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi weyob soged:

content.text: Yamo ise-dakarsuli, gwa-gwagwen san-goagan-bormoyagi-bukwad be sue.
An sae-itogegala, an buged-mai imakegala, ablis-eolesad akwa-dummad-birgi-dinguega an imakoed.”

content: Degisoggu, Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi weyob soged:

content.text: Bela san-nis dinnaa guedse an imakoed,
degi, bela garmar gummakedse an saoed.
Geb sorbali, sooyagi bormo-ollogwad an sioed,

content: ”Jerusalén-neggwebur, be-galagwensuli-gudigusad an bega elibi gusanad, ar bedi bega-elied gwen abessulid. A-ulale, an-sae-itogedba-sabsur-be-odurdakoed-sorbali, geb be swilidik gunonisunnoed.

”Ani an Bab-Jehová-guedi we-ibmar soged. An we-ibmar imakedsegad. An-sunnad an imakoed, an sikirmakosulid. An wile-be-dakosulid, deginbali, an ibmar-sogsad an gannar-osulogosurbalid. Be-daedba, be-ibmar-imakedba an bega igar-nabogoed. Ani an Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi weyob soged.”
Ezequiel-ome-burgwisad
Bab-Jehová anga sogdebalid:
“Dule-machi, be-ome na be bela-bela-binasogdiid ukiagwale, an be-ibe suoed.
Wakdaradba dulemarga an sunmaksagua, sedogidba an-ome burgwisad. Bangine, anga-ibmar-soglesadba, an ibmar imaksad.
Dulemar anga sokalid: —Anmarga be soge, be weyob-daedi, ¿ibi anmarga obare?
Geb dulemarga an sogde gusad: —Bab-Jehová weyob anga sogsad, weyob anga igar uksabalid.

Israel-dulemarga iduakwaa ibmar be sogo, weyob Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi sogye: ” ‘Anse-goled-nega an obelogoye. We-nega bemar-gangued-dummarba-imaked-negad. Na be we-neg yeer dakdimalad. Na be we-negbina bela-bela-sogdimaladi, an obelogoye. Degi, Jerusalénʼgi be machimala-obes alidi, bunamala-obes alidi, es-suidgi burgwemaloye.’ ”
Emide, bemar anyopira imakmarmogoed:
Bab-Jehová sogdebalid: “Ezequiel bemarga wilubga guoed. Ezequiel-ibmar-imaksayob be samarmogoed. Ar ibmar weyob gusale, bemar wisgumaloed, ani an Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi gue.

”Dule-machi-Ezequiel, anse-goled-neg an obelogoed. We-nega we-dulemar-gangued-dummarba-imaked-negad. Na we-dulemar, we-neg yeer dakdimalad. We-dulemar, we-negbina bela-bela-sogdimaladi, an obelogoed. Degi, Jerusalénʼgi e-machimala-besmaladi, e-bunamala-besmaladi, es-suidgi anse oburgwilegoed. Deyob-neg-guoed-ibagine,
dule-gwensak-wakinnoedi bega gayaburba sognonikoed.
A-ibagine, be-gwabin bega nollomakdoed, geb nabir be sunmakdoed. Geb degine, dule-wakicha-nonikidbo be sunmakoed. Wemarga be wilubga guoed, degidbali, na wisgumaloed, ani an Bab-Jehová gue.”
